run_image_projection: run the projector CLI to project a target image into the latent W space of a pretrained network
project_image_to_latent: project a target image tensor to the latent space of a pretrained StyleGAN generator using VGG16 perceptual loss
optimize_w_vector: optimize a W latent vector by minimizing perceptual distance between a synthesized image and a target image
save_projection_video: save an MP4 video showing the optimization progress of projecting an image to latent space
export_projected_w: export the final projected W vector as an NPZ file for downstream inference
